Name: Jen's Improved Standard Farm
Author: jenf1
Description:
[size=3][b]This mod is only available here at Nexus Mods! If you see it anywhere else, it has been uploaded without my permission and should be taken down immediately![/b][/size]

[size=5]Features:[/size]

- A fully grassy standard farm replacement, all tiles are tillable
- Smaller pond is relocated behind the farmhouse, with a small waterfall added
- Bigger pond is moved off to the side, allowing the north and south exits to be connected seamlessly with paths
- Protruding cliff is now gone

[size=5]Install:[/size]

- Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
- Copy [CP] Jen's Improved Standard Farm into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
- Load the game using SMAPI and enjoy!
